relations: Low sun above the horizon projects a vertical bright reflection column stretching toward the foreground.
Small surface ripples within the column break the light into shifting shimmering highlights.
Calm water beyond the column mirrors the pale sky with minimal drift.
Steady sun and horizon keep the overall composition largely unchanged.
caption: The video captures a wide, aerial-style view of the sun hanging low on the horizon above a vast, calm body of water. A bright vertical column of light reflects off the surface, stretching from the horizon line toward the foreground. The sky is layered with thin, scattered clouds, warmed by a soft glow near the horizon. Throughout, the sun and horizon line appear largely steady, with little visible drift in the cloud formations. The clearest motion is a subtle, continuous shimmering within the bright reflection, where small ripples break the column of light into shifting highlights. Beyond this column the water remains calm and glassy, mirroring the pale sky. The overall composition stays largely unchanged, presenting a tranquil, near-still seascape.
